messages:
oncall-alex: paging chain last night was messy — thanks everyone who jumped in. we got the customer-facing systems back at 02:17 but we had multiple handoffs and no clear postmortem ticket created automatically.

oncall-alex: I want to get a quick follow-up: can we standardize automation so incident-bot creates a postmortem draft w/ timeline + participants right after an incident is marked resolved? currently that step is manual and it slips. :exclamation:

incident-bot: logged alert stream: cluster-gpu-3 OOM spike -> autoscaler thrash -> 5m degraded responses. Incident created: 1764266801. Automated traces and logs attached to the incident.

sre-maya: +1 to automating the draft. during the outage we lost ~8 mins while ownership bounced between infra and serving. If the bot can prefill a timeline block with the alert stream and handoff messages, that would save time.

eng-jordan: do we have a standard postmortem template anywhere? I can wire the bot to hit an API if we standardize the fields.

pm-lee: we do have one in docs, but it's scattered. Proposal: canonical template with these sections: Impact summary, Timeline, Root cause, Mitigation, Action items, Customer comms. If incident-bot can create a ticket in our PM tool with those sections prefilled, that'd be ideal.

ops-taylor: +1. also recommend the bot attaches the initial CPU/GPU metrics and a short permalink to the traces view. ops folks should be able to add remediation steps quickly.

oncall-alex: rough workflow I'm imagining:

1) incident resolves -> incident-bot auto-generates postmortem draft in #postmortems and creates PM ticket with draft content
2) bot includes timeline scraped from incident chat + alert logs + a required "customer impact" field that PMs must fill
3) action items get created as checklist items in the ticket with owner suggestions populated from slack mentions

sre-maya: sounds good. for owner suggestions, the bot can look at last 3 active participants and the code owners for the services in the incident. fallback to oncall rotation owner.

eng-jordan: here's a minimal API payload we can use for the bot to create a draft (pseudo):

```
POST /api/postmortems
{
  "incident_id": "1764266801",
  "title": "auto-draft: cluster-gpu-3 OOM spike",
  "template": "redwood-standard-v1",
  "timeline_snippet": "<auto-scraped chat + alerts>",
  "suggested_action_items": ["pin model to older quantized build","increase autoscaler cooldown"],
  "suggested_owners": ["sre-maya","eng-jordan"]
}
```

pm-lee: love that. can we also have the bot post a short reactable checklist in the thread so people can quickly claim items? e.g., \"ops-taylor: take remediation 1 -> react with :white_check_mark: to claim\"

ops-taylor: yes, a reaction-driven claim flow would help during follow-ups. low friction.

sre-maya: one more ask: include a small "evidence snapshot" section with a single-line summary of the strongest signal (e.g., "OOMs on worker-7 at 02:03; eviction thrash observed on 02:05"). keeps the initial draft focused.

oncall-alex: actionable items from this thread (assignments & tentative due dates):
- oncall-alex: draft a spec for incident-bot auto-postmortem (due 2026-03-22)
- eng-jordan: implement API hook for creating PM tickets, support template v1 (due 2026-03-29)
- sre-maya: add timeline scraper + evidence snapshot logic to incident-bot (due 2026-03-29)
- pm-lee: coordinate customer impact statement and review process (due 2026-03-24)
- ops-taylor: implement reaction-claim UX in thread and brief doc for rotation (due 2026-03-26)

incident-bot: noted action items created: #PM-4123 (auto-postmortem-spec), #PM-4124 (bot-ticket-hook), #PM-4125 (timeline-scraper), #PM-4126 (customer-impact-proc). Links posted to channel.

eng-jordan: I'll start a branch today for the hook. question: how do we want to store postmortem drafts? in PM tool or a git-backed markdown repo?

pm-lee: prefer PM tool as single source of truth for tracking and action item dashboards. can export to git for archival if needed.

sre-maya: ok. small caveat: ensure export keeps raw logs attached somewhere durable (S3) and bot includes S3 links. don't bloat PM tool.

oncall-alex: next steps: i'll run a quick follow-up session tomorrow 10am to review the spec and landing plan. please add blockers in the PM tickets. thanks all — this should cut our post-incident lag a lot. :rocket:
